Mashable Trend Report

This is one of our favorite early deals on robot lawn mowers. Normally priced at $3,699.99, it's been marked down to $1,799.99 after checking the coupon box on the store page. That amounts to a massive $1,900 in savings and is the lowest price ever. It's only available for a limited time, so now is your chance to save.

It can handle up to 0.87 acres. It can also climb slopes up to 38.7 degrees, so if your yard's a bit bumpy, it can still move around and make sure there's no uneven spots. As for the mowing itself, it comes with dual cutting discs that have a 15.8-inch cutting width and EdgeMaster 2.0 technology that reaches the borders around your yard.

It also has OmniSense 3.0 technology, which combines 360-degree 3D LiDAR and Binocular AI Vision for navigation. With these, the mower can map out your yard and note any obstacles in its way so it can get an even cut. When the mower's battery gets too low, it automatically records its position and heads to the charging station. Then it can pick up right where it left off.

This incredible deal may not be available for long. Don't miss out on $1,900 off the Dreame LiDAR A3 AWD Pro 3500 robot lawn mower at Amazon.
